title: Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net: Coarse-Global and Local-Residual Representations for Artifact-Reduced PDE Operator Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.08034v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Localized dimensionality reduction improves the scalability of operator learning for high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs), but independently decoded local patches can introduce block offsets, interface mismatches, and spurious high-wavenumber content. We introduce Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net, which decomposes the solution into a coarse-global component and local residual corrections. A compact global PCA basis captures domain-scale structure, while nonoverlapping local PCA bases represent the remaining fine-scale residual. A block-balanced latent objective couples the two representations, and optional interface-aware fine-tuning further promotes continuity through reconstruction and trace losses. translated_title: 双尺度局部化PCA-Net：用于伪影削减的PDE算子学习的粗全局与局部残差表示
translated_abstract: 局部化降维可以提升高维偏微分方程（PDE）算子学习的可扩展性，但独立解码的局部块可能引入块间偏移、界面失配以及虚假的高波数内容。我们提出了双尺度局部化PCA-Net（Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net），该方法将解分解为粗全局分量和局部残差修正。一个紧凑的全局PCA基用于捕获域尺度结构，而非重叠的局部PCA基表示剩余的细尺度残差。块平衡的潜在目标函数将两种表示耦合起来，可选的界面感知微调则通过重建损失和迹损失进一步促进连续性。在泊松方程基准测试中，相较于普通及基于重叠的局部化PCA-Net，双尺度表示显著降低了重建误差和可见的块状伪影，同时将PCA拟合成本大约减半。
tldr: 提出双尺度局部化PCA-Net，通过粗全局PCA基与局部残差PCA基相结合的表示方法，在将PCA拟合成本减半的同时，显著降低了PDE算子学习中的重建误差与块状伪影。
en_tdlr: Two-Scale Localized PCA-Net combines a coarse-global PCA basis with local-residual PCA representations to substantially reduce reconstruction error and block artifacts in PDE operator learning while approximately halving the PCA fitting cost.
